blocks.zh: Section V: Stage 3 — Continued Process Verification | 第三階段：持續製程查驗
blocks.en: Section V: Stage 3 — Continued Process Verification

blocks.zh: + Section V: Concurrent Release of PPQ Batches | 同期放行
blocks.en: + Section V: Concurrent Release of PPQ Batches

blocks.zh: Core Principle | 核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principle

blocks.zh:
Stage 3 closes the validation lifecycle loop — a product is only fully validated when you have ongoing evidence from commercial production demonstrating the process remains in a state of control.
第三階段閉合驗證生命週期迴路——唯有來自商業生產的持續證據，才能證明製程真正處於受控狀態。
blocks.en: Stage 3 closes the validation lifecycle loop — a product is only fully validated when you have ongoing evidence from commercial production demonstrating the process remains in a state of control.

blocks.en: Define Stage 3 Continued Process Verification (CPV) and its role in the validation lifecycle

blocks.zh: 為商業生產設計統計上合理的資料收集與趨勢分析計畫
blocks.en: Design a statistically sound data collection and trending plan for commercial production

blocks.zh: 區分 Cpk 與 Ppk 指數，並應用於製程能力評估
blocks.en: Distinguish between the Cpk and Ppk indices and apply them to process capability assessment

blocks.zh: 生命週期定位 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Lifecycle Positioning — Commentary

blocks.zh: 三階段生命週期邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of the Three-Stage Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 第一階段（製程設計）：了解製程，識別關鍵製程參數（CPP）與關鍵品質屬性（CQA）
blocks.en: Stage 1 (Process Design): understand the process and identify the critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs)

blocks.zh: 第二階段（製程確認 PPQ）：在商業規模下執行，確認製程能重複生產符合規格的產品
blocks.en: Stage 2 (Process Qualification, PPQ): perform at commercial scale to confirm the process can repeatedly produce product that meets specifications

blocks.zh: 第三階段（CPV）：商業生產過程中持續監控，確認製程維持受控狀態
blocks.en: Stage 3 (CPV): monitor continuously during commercial production to confirm the process remains in a state of control

blocks.zh: 比喻：駕照考試 vs. 日常駕駛
blocks.en: Analogy: Driving Test vs. Daily Driving

blocks.zh: 第二階段 PPQ 如同考取駕照（通過測驗，取得資格）。第三階段 CPV 則是每天上路行駛——真正的安全記錄來自於持續的行為，而非一次考試。
blocks.en: Stage 2 PPQ is like passing the driving test (you pass the exam and earn the licence). Stage 3 CPV is driving on the road every day: a real safety record comes from sustained behavior, not from a single exam.

blocks.zh: 傳統「三批次驗證」的思維等同於：只要考一次試，就永遠不需要再證明自己還會開車。FDA 2011 指引明確拒絕了這種思維。
blocks.en: The traditional "three-batch validation" mindset is equivalent to saying that once you have passed the test, you never need to show again that you can drive. The 2011 FDA guidance explicitly rejects this thinking.

blocks.zh: 重點：為什麼 CPV 是閉合迴路的關鍵？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Is CPV the Key to Closing the Loop?

blocks.zh: Stage 1+2 的資料量有限（通常只有 3–10 批次）。真正代表商業製程變異性的資料，只有在 Stage 3 大量批次生產後才能獲得。CPV 讓驗證從「靜態證明」轉為「動態保證」。
blocks.en: Stage 1 and 2 data are limited (typically only 3-10 batches). Data that truly represent commercial process variability become available only after many batches have been produced in Stage 3. CPV turns validation from "static proof" into "dynamic assurance".

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise

blocks.zh: 一家製藥公司完成了 3 批 PPQ 並通過放行，但之後從未建立 CPV 計畫。這符合 FDA 2011 的期望嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical company completed 3 PPQ batches and released them, but never established a CPV program. Does this meet FDA 2011 expectations? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 第一階段識別出填充量變異的主要因子是活塞磨損。在 CPV 計畫中，您會如何監控這個因子？
blocks.en: Stage 1 identified piston wear as the main contributor to fill-volume variability. How would you monitor this factor in the CPV program?

blocks.zh: Block 2 | 第二區塊 — Stage 3 Definition & Regulatory Framework | 第三階段定義與法規架構
blocks.en: Block 2 — Stage 3 Definition & Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 第三階段定義 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Stage 3 Definition — Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心定義：CPV（Continued Process Verification）
blocks.en: Core Definition: CPV (Continued Process Verification)

blocks.zh: 持續製程查驗是指在商業生產期間，透過系統性的資料收集、統計分析與趨勢監控，持續確認製程保持在已驗證的受控狀態。
blocks.en: Continued process verification means continually confirming, through systematic data collection, statistical analysis and trend monitoring during commercial production, that the process remains in the validated state of control.

blocks.zh: 目標：偵測非預期的製程偏離
blocks.en: Objective: detect unplanned process deviations

blocks.zh: 手段：統計方法 + 訓練人員審核
blocks.en: Means: statistical methods + review by trained personnel

blocks.zh: 法規依據：21 CFR § 211.180(e)
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: 21 CFR § 211.180(e)

blocks.zh: 資料範圍：原料、中間品、成品、製程參數
blocks.en: Data scope: raw materials, in-process materials, finished product, process parameters
Regulatory Link: § 211.180(e)

blocks.zh: 此條款要求製造商建立書面程序，定期評估製造記錄，以確認批次始終符合既定標準。CPV 計畫是滿足此要求的主要機制。
blocks.en: This provision requires manufacturers to establish written procedures and periodically evaluate manufacturing records to confirm that batches consistently meet established standards. The CPV program is the primary mechanism for meeting this requirement.

blocks.zh: FDA 明確建議由統計學家或具備充分 SPC 訓練的人員來設計資料收集計畫——這意味著 CPV 不是 QA 任意決定抽幾個點的事，而是需要統計學設計。
blocks.en: FDA expressly recommends that a statistician or person with adequate training in statistical process control (SPC) design the data collection plan. In other words, CPV is not a matter of QA arbitrarily choosing a few sampling points; it requires statistical design.

blocks.zh: 比喻：血壓監測 vs. 健康體檢
blocks.en: Analogy: Blood Pressure Monitoring vs. a Health Check-up

blocks.zh: PPQ（第二階段）如同一次完整的健康體檢——深入但不頻繁。CPV 則像每天量血壓——不那麼深入，但持續追蹤趨勢，能在問題惡化前發出警告。
blocks.en: PPQ (Stage 2) is like a full health check-up: thorough but infrequent. CPV is like measuring blood pressure every day: less in-depth, but it tracks the trend continuously and warns you before a problem worsens.

blocks.zh: 只做體檢不量血壓，你可能在兩次體檢之間悄悄發展出高血壓危機。製程也是如此。
blocks.en: If you only have check-ups and never measure blood pressure, a hypertensive crisis can quietly develop between two check-ups. The same is true of a process.

blocks.zh: FDA 建議由「統計學家或受過充分 SPC 訓練的人員」設計資料收集計畫。在您的組織中，誰最可能負責這項工作？這個責任目前是否明確？
blocks.en: FDA recommends that "a statistician or person with adequate training in statistical process control techniques" design the data collection plan. Who in your organization is most likely to take on this work? Is this responsibility currently clearly assigned?

blocks.zh: § 211.180(e) 要求定期評估製造記錄。「定期」在您公司的 SOP 中如何定義？月度？季度？批次基礎？
blocks.en: § 211.180(e) requires periodic evaluation of manufacturing records. How is "periodic" defined in your company SOP? Monthly? Quarterly? Batch by batch?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 CDMO 同時生產 15 種產品，每種產品都需要獨立的 CPV 計畫，這在資源上有何挑戰？如何優先排序？
blocks.en: If a CDMO manufactures 15 products at the same time and each requires its own CPV plan, what resource challenges does this create? How would you prioritize?

blocks.zh: Block 3 | 第三區塊 — Data Collection & Sampling Program | 資料收集與取樣計畫
blocks.en: Block 3 — Data Collection & Sampling Program

blocks.zh: 資料收集計畫 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Data Collection Plan — Commentary

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫設計原則
blocks.en: Principles of Sampling Plan Design

blocks.zh: FDA 建議的取樣策略分為兩個階段：
blocks.en: FDA recommends a two-phase sampling strategy:

blocks.zh: 早期商業化階段：維持 PPQ 階段的取樣頻率與數量，持續收集直到有足夠資料估計製程變異性
blocks.en: Early commercialization phase: maintain the sampling frequency and number used during PPQ, and keep collecting data until there are enough to estimate process variability

blocks.zh: 穩定後階段：根據統計分析結果，調整至「統計上合適且具代表性」的常規水準
blocks.en: Post-stabilization phase: based on the statistical analysis, adjust to a routine level that is "statistically appropriate and representative"

blocks.zh: 關鍵字：statistically appropriate and representative — 不是越多越好，也不是越少越省事，而是根據資料說話。
blocks.en: Key phrase: statistically appropriate and representative — more is not always better, and less is not simply cheaper; let the data decide.

blocks.zh: 資料來源全景圖
blocks.en: Overview of Data Sources

blocks.zh: CPV 不只是看檢驗數據，還涵蓋：
blocks.en: CPV is not just about looking at test results. It also covers:

blocks.zh: 製程參數（溫度、壓力、速度、填充量等）
blocks.en: Process parameters (temperature, pressure, speed, fill volume, etc.)

blocks.zh: 中間品檢測結果
blocks.en: In-process test results

blocks.zh: 成品放行數據
blocks.en: Finished-product release data

blocks.zh: 原物料 CoA 與放行趨勢
blocks.en: Raw material CoA and release trends

blocks.zh: 客訴與不良反應報告
blocks.en: Complaints and adverse event reports

blocks.zh: 批次良率變異
blocks.en: Batch yield variability

blocks.zh: 偏差與 CAPA 記錄
blocks.en: Deviation and CAPA records

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌灌裝環境中還需加入：環境監測數據（EM）、培養基模擬試驗（MFT）結果、容器封閉完整性測試（CCIT）趨勢。
blocks.en: In a CDMO aseptic fill-finish environment, also include: environmental monitoring (EM) data, media fill (MFT) results, and container closure integrity testing (CCIT) trends.

blocks.zh: 您的產品完成 PPQ 後已生產 12 批，填充重量 Cpk = 1.45。FDA 會認為這是「足夠資料」可以降低取樣頻率的信號嗎？需要額外考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: Your product has had 12 batches produced since PPQ, with a fill-weight Cpk of 1.45. Would FDA regard this as a sign of "sufficient data" to reduce the sampling frequency? What additional factors need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 原料 CoA 的趨勢監控是否屬於 CPV 的範疇？請說明理由並舉例。
blocks.en: Does trend monitoring of raw material CoA data fall within the scope of CPV? Explain your reasoning and give an example.

blocks.zh: 雙向錯誤：過度反應 vs. 遲鈍
blocks.en: Two-Way Error: Overreacting vs. Being Sluggish

blocks.zh: 正確設計的 SPC 計畫（加上明確的管制界限規則）可以平衡這兩種錯誤。
blocks.en: A properly designed SPC program (with clear control-limit rules) can balance these two types of error.

blocks.zh: Block 4 | 第四區塊 — SPC Tools: Cpk vs. Ppk | 統計製程管制工具
blocks.en: Block 4 — SPC Tools: Cpk vs. Ppk

blocks.zh: Cpk vs. Ppk 深度解析
blocks.en: Cpk vs. Ppk in Depth

blocks.zh: Cpk 公式
blocks.en: Cpk Formula

blocks.zh: Ppk 公式
blocks.en: Ppk Formula

blocks.zh: 比喻：短跑 vs. 馬拉松
blocks.en: Analogy: Sprint vs. Marathon

blocks.zh: Cpk 像是短跑成績——在最佳狀態、最短時間內的表現。Ppk 像是全年所有比賽的平均成績——包含了天氣、體力狀態、場地等所有實際條件的影響。
blocks.en: Cpk is like a sprint time: performance under the best conditions over the shortest period. Ppk is like the average result across all races in a year, including the effects of weather, fitness, venue and every other real-world condition.

blocks.zh: 對於法規申請（NDA/BLA），FDA 更關注 Ppk，因為它反映的是真實商業生產的全貌。
blocks.en: For regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA), FDA pays more attention to Ppk because it reflects the full picture of real commercial production.

blocks.zh: 您的凍乾產品水分含量：USL = 3.0%，LSL = 0.5%，X̄ = 1.8%，σ_within = 0.25%，σ_total = 0.45%。計算 Cpk 和 Ppk，並解讀結果。
blocks.en: For your lyophilized product, moisture content: USL = 3.0%, LSL = 0.5%, X̄ = 1.8%, σ_within = 0.25%, σ_total = 0.45%. Calculate Cpk and Ppk and interpret the results.

blocks.zh: Cpk = 1.52 但 Ppk = 0.98。這說明了什麼問題？您會建議調查哪些方面？
blocks.en: Cpk = 1.52 but Ppk = 0.98. What does this tell you? What areas would you recommend investigating?

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝的可見異物（VPI）屬性是否適合用 Cpk/Ppk 分析？為什麼？應使用什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: Is the visible particulate (VPI) attribute of aseptic filling suitable for Cpk/Ppk analysis? Why or why not? What alternative method should be used?

blocks.zh: Block 5 | 第五區塊 — Control Charts: Xbar-R & Other Tools | 管制圖與 SPC 工具
blocks.en: Block 5 — Control Charts: Xbar-R & Other Tools

blocks.zh: 管制圖詳解 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Control Charts in Detail — Commentary

blocks.zh: Xbar-R Chart 結構示意
blocks.en: Xbar-R Chart Structure

blocks.zh:
Xbar Chart (均值圖):
  UCL_X = X̄̄ + A2 × R̄     ← 上管制界限
  CL_X  = X̄̄               ← 中心線（總均值）
  LCL_X = X̄̄ - A2 × R̄     ← 下管制界限

R Chart (全距圖):
  UCL_R = D4 × R̄           ← 上管制界限
  CL_R  = R̄                ← 中心線（平均全距）
  LCL_R = D3 × R̄           ← 下管制界限（n≤6時=0）

常用係數 (n=5):
  A2 = 0.577, D3 = 0, D4 = 2.114

圖示 (填充重量, mg):
  UCL_X ─────────────────── 502.8
        ●   ●           ●
  CL_X  ─── ─── ─── ─── ─── 501.0
              ●   ●
  LCL_X ─────────────────── 499.2

  批次:    1   2   3   4   5
blocks.en:
Xbar Chart (mean chart):
  UCL_X = X̄̄ + A2 × R̄     ← upper control limit
  CL_X  = X̄̄               ← center line (grand mean)
  LCL_X = X̄̄ - A2 × R̄     ← lower control limit

R Chart (range chart):
  UCL_R = D4 × R̄           ← upper control limit
  CL_R  = R̄                ← center line (mean range)
  LCL_R = D3 × R̄           ← lower control limit (= 0 when n≤6)

Common coefficients (n=5):
  A2 = 0.577, D3 = 0, D4 = 2.114

Illustration (fill weight, mg):
  UCL_X ─────────────────── 502.8
        ●   ●           ●
  CL_X  ─── ─── ─── ─── ─── 501.0
              ●   ●
  LCL_X ─────────────────── 499.2

  Batch:   1   2   3   4   5

blocks.zh: I-MR Chart — 無菌灌裝常用場景
blocks.en: I-MR Chart — A Common Scenario in Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: 當每批只有一個量測值（如：每批取一個容器做蛋白質含量測試），使用 I-MR chart：
blocks.en: When there is only one measurement per batch (for example, one container per batch tested for protein content), use an I-MR chart:

blocks.zh: I chart（個別值圖）：監控每批測值
blocks.en: I chart (individuals chart): monitors each batch result

blocks.zh: MR chart（移動全距圖）：監控批次間變異
blocks.en: MR chart (moving range chart): monitors batch-to-batch variation

blocks.zh: 適用場景：凍乾產品含水量趨勢、無菌測試通過率（批次）、ABI（生物指標滅菌挑戰）結果
blocks.en: Applicable scenarios: moisture content trends of lyophilized product, sterility test pass rate (by batch), BI (biological indicator sterilization challenge) results

blocks.zh: 比喻：交通號誌系統
blocks.en: Analogy: Traffic Signals

blocks.zh: 管制界限（UCL/LCL）是紅燈——超過必須停車調查。規格界限（USL/LSL）是懸崖邊緣——到達時已太晚。SPC 的目的是讓你在「看見黃燈」時就採取行動，而不是等到撞上懸崖才反應。
blocks.en: Control limits (UCL/LCL) are the red light: when exceeded, you must stop and investigate. Specification limits (USL/LSL) are the edge of the cliff: by the time you reach them, it is too late. The purpose of SPC is to act when you "see the yellow light", not to react after you have hit the cliff.

blocks.zh: 管制界限通常比規格界限窄得多。如果管制界限 = 規格界限，SPC 就失去了早期預警的功能。
blocks.en: Control limits are usually much narrower than specification limits. If the control limits equal the specification limits, SPC loses its early-warning function.

blocks.zh: 填充量 X̄̄ = 10.0 mL，R̄ = 0.12 mL，n = 5（A2 = 0.577）。計算 Xbar chart 的 UCL 和 LCL。如果第 15 批的 X̄ = 10.07 mL，是否有失控訊號？
blocks.en: Fill volume X̄̄ = 10.0 mL, R̄ = 0.12 mL, n = 5 (A2 = 0.577). Calculate the UCL and LCL of the Xbar chart. If batch 15 has X̄ = 10.07 mL, is there an out-of-control signal?

blocks.zh: 您的 Xbar chart 顯示連續 9 批數值都在中心線上方，但沒有超出 UCL。這是否需要調查？依據哪條規則？
blocks.en: Your Xbar chart shows 9 consecutive batches above the center line, none exceeding the UCL. Does this need to be investigated? Under which rule?

blocks.zh: 無菌測試結果（通過/失敗）適合使用哪種管制圖？Xbar-R chart 適用嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which type of control chart suits sterility test results (pass/fail)? Is an Xbar-R chart applicable? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: Block 6 | 第六區塊 — Sources of Variation & Trend Analysis | 變異來源與趨勢分析
blocks.en: Block 6 — Sources of Variation & Trend Analysis

blocks.zh: 變異來源與趨勢分析 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Sources of Variation and Trend Analysis — Commentary

blocks.zh: FDA 重點：QA 與生產的定期會議
blocks.en: FDA Key Point: Regular QA and Production Meetings

blocks.zh: FDA 明確建議品質單位定期與生產人員開會評估資料，討論趨勢。這不是法規形式要求，而是 FDA 認為這種跨職能溝通是早期發現問題的必要條件。
blocks.en: FDA expressly recommends that the quality unit meet regularly with production personnel to evaluate data and discuss trends. This is not a formal regulatory requirement, but FDA considers such cross-functional communication essential for detecting problems early.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：每月一次 CPV 趨勢檢討會議（Monthly CPV Review Meeting），議程包含：
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: hold a Monthly CPV Review Meeting, with an agenda that includes:

blocks.zh: 管制圖更新與異常點回顧
blocks.en: Control chart updates and review of anomalous points

blocks.zh: Cpk/Ppk 月度計算
blocks.en: Monthly Cpk/Ppk calculation

blocks.zh: OOT 案例討論
blocks.en: Discussion of OOT cases

blocks.zh: CAPA 執行狀態追蹤
blocks.en: CAPA implementation status tracking

blocks.zh: 下月重點監控項目
blocks.en: Priority monitoring items for next month

blocks.zh: 比喻：天氣預報 vs. 天氣記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: Weather Forecast vs. Weather Record

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析的目的是「預報」，不只是「記錄」。看到夏季 EM 數據連續 3 個月緩慢上升——即使尚未超標——就應該在超標前啟動調查。這就是 Stage 3 CPV 的精髓：預防性而非反應性。
blocks.en: The purpose of trend analysis is to "forecast", not just to "record". If you see EM data rising slowly for 3 consecutive months in summer, even if no limit has been exceeded, you should start an investigation before it is. This is the essence of Stage 3 CPV: preventive rather than reactive.

blocks.zh: 您發現夜班的填充量 Cpk 持續低於白班（1.15 vs 1.42）。這是否構成 OOT 事件？應如何調查根本原因？
blocks.en: You find that the night-shift fill-volume Cpk is consistently lower than the day shift (1.15 vs. 1.42). Does this constitute an OOT event? How would you investigate the root cause?

blocks.zh: 季節性變異（如夏季潔淨室 EM 微生物數量增加）是否在 Stage 1 設計時就應考慮？如果未考慮，在 Stage 3 發現後如何處理？
blocks.en: Should seasonal variation (for example, higher microbial counts in cleanroom EM in summer) have been considered during Stage 1 design? If it was not, how should it be handled once discovered in Stage 3?

blocks.zh: Block 7 | 第七區塊 — CPV Program Elements Checklist | CPV 計畫要素核查清單
blocks.en: Block 7 — CPV Program Elements Checklist

blocks.zh: CPV 計畫要素 — 完整核查清單
blocks.en: CPV Program Elements — Full Checklist

blocks.zh: CPV 計畫 13 大要素核查清單
blocks.en: 13-Element CPV Program Checklist

blocks.zh: CPV 計畫書（書面程序，含範圍、責任分工）
blocks.en: CPV plan (written procedure, including scope and responsibilities)

blocks.zh: 監控參數清單（CPP 與 CQA 全覆蓋）
blocks.en: List of monitored parameters (full coverage of CPPs and CQAs)

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫（頻率、數量、取樣點、統計依據）
blocks.en: Sampling plan (frequency, quantity, sampling points, statistical rationale)

blocks.zh: 統計方法規格（控制圖類型、Cpk/Ppk 計算方法）
blocks.en: Statistical method specifications (control chart types, Cpk/Ppk calculation methods)

blocks.zh: 管制界限（UCL/LCL）與警戒界限設定依據
blocks.en: Rationale for setting control limits (UCL/LCL) and alert limits

blocks.zh: 趨勢報告格式與審核頻率
blocks.en: Trend report format and review frequency

blocks.zh: OOT 定義與調查啟動標準
blocks.en: OOT definition and investigation trigger criteria

blocks.zh: OOT → OOS 升級路徑
blocks.en: OOT to OOS escalation path

blocks.zh: CAPA 整合機制（調查 → 根本原因 → 糾正預防）
blocks.en: CAPA integration mechanism (investigation, root cause, corrective and preventive action)

blocks.zh: 定期 CPV 審查會議（議程、頻率、參與者）
blocks.en: Periodic CPV review meetings (agenda, frequency, participants)

blocks.zh: 年度產品品質回顧（APR/PQR）整合
blocks.en: Integration with the annual product quality review (APR/PQR)

blocks.zh: 變更管理整合（製程改善需通過變更管制）
blocks.en: Change management integration (process improvements must go through change control)

blocks.zh: 培訓要求（統計人員、操作人員、QA）
blocks.en: Training requirements (statisticians, operators, QA)

blocks.zh: PQR/APR — 年度產品品質回顧
blocks.en: PQR/APR — Annual Product Quality Review

blocks.zh: Product Quality Review (PQR)，在美國 CGMP 中稱為 Annual Product Review（APR），是 CPV 的年度總結機制，要求：
blocks.en: Product Quality Review (PQR), called the Annual Product Review (APR) under US CGMP, is the annual summary mechanism of CPV and requires:

blocks.zh: 回顧所有批次的生產與放行數據
blocks.en: Review of production and release data for all batches

blocks.zh: 分析 OOS、OOT、偏差趨勢
blocks.en: Analysis of OOS, OOT and deviation trends

blocks.zh: 評估 CAPA 有效性
blocks.en: Evaluation of CAPA effectiveness

blocks.zh: 原料供應商評估
blocks.en: Evaluation of raw material suppliers

blocks.zh: 穩定性資料更新
blocks.en: Update of stability data

blocks.zh: 製程能力趨勢（Cpk/Ppk 年度比較）
blocks.en: Process capability trends (year-on-year comparison of Cpk/Ppk)

blocks.zh: 識別改善機會與需再驗證的觸發點
blocks.en: Identification of improvement opportunities and triggers for revalidation

blocks.zh: 法規依據：21 CFR § 211.180(e)（美國）、EU GMP Chapter 1 §1.10（歐盟）
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: 21 CFR § 211.180(e) (US), EU GMP Chapter 1 §1.10 (EU)

blocks.zh: 您被要求為新產品建立 CPV 計畫。您會從 13 項清單中的哪個項目開始，為什麼？
blocks.en: You are asked to establish a CPV program for a new product. Which of the 13 items would you start with, and why?

blocks.zh: 警戒界限（Alert Limit）與管制界限（Control Limit / UCL/LCL）有何不同？超出警戒界限時應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: How do an alert limit and a control limit (UCL/LCL) differ? What action should be taken when an alert limit is exceeded?

blocks.zh: PQR 顯示過去一年 Cpk 從 1.52 降至 1.18，但始終高於 1.00。這是否需要正式調查？應在 PQR 中如何記錄？
blocks.en: The PQR shows that Cpk fell from 1.52 to 1.18 over the past year, but has always stayed above 1.00. Does this require a formal investigation? How should it be documented in the PQR?

blocks.zh: Block 8 | 第八區塊 — OOT vs. OOS Investigation | 超趨勢 vs. 超規格調查
blocks.en: Block 8 — OOT vs. OOS Investigation

blocks.zh: OOT vs. OOS 決策矩陣
blocks.en: OOT vs. OOS Decision Matrix

blocks.zh: OOT → OOS 決策流程
blocks.en: OOT to OOS Decision Flow

blocks.zh: 步驟 1：偵測 OOT 訊號（超出管制界限或觸發趨勢規則）
blocks.en: Step 1: detect the OOT signal (control limit exceeded or trend rule triggered)

blocks.zh: 步驟 2：啟動 OOT 調查——是否為計算錯誤或儀器問題？
blocks.en: Step 2: initiate the OOT investigation: is it a calculation error or an instrument problem?

blocks.zh: 步驟 3：確認 OOT 屬實——執行根本原因分析
blocks.en: Step 3: confirm the OOT is valid and perform root cause analysis

blocks.zh: 步驟 4：判斷是否已達規格界限或有升級 OOS 風險
blocks.en: Step 4: determine whether the specification limit has been reached or there is a risk of escalation to OOS

blocks.zh: 步驟 5：若升級為 OOS，啟動 § 211.192 正式調查
blocks.en: Step 5: if escalated to OOS, start a formal § 211.192 investigation

blocks.zh: 步驟 6：實施 CAPA，持續監控改善效果
blocks.en: Step 6: implement CAPA and continue monitoring the effect of the improvement

blocks.zh: 比喻：體溫計 vs. 急診
blocks.en: Analogy: Thermometer vs. Emergency Room

blocks.zh: OOT 如同體溫達到 37.5°C（輕微偏高）——需要關注、多喝水、休息，但還不用去急診。OOS 如同體溫達到 40°C——必須立即就醫，這是緊急事件。
blocks.en: OOT is like a body temperature of 37.5°C (slightly elevated): it needs attention, fluids and rest, but not yet a trip to the emergency room. OOS is like a temperature of 40°C: you must seek medical care immediately, as this is an emergency.

blocks.zh: 好的 CPV 系統在你「還只是 37.5°C」時就介入，防止惡化到 40°C。這就是為什麼 OOT 系統的設計至關重要。
blocks.en: A good CPV system steps in while you are "only at 37.5°C" to prevent it worsening to 40°C. This is why the design of the OOT system is so important.

blocks.zh: OOT 定義的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Defining OOT

blocks.zh: OOT 沒有像 OOS 那樣有明確的法規定義，各公司需要在 SOP 中自行定義觸發標準。常見定義方式：
blocks.en: Unlike OOS, OOT has no clear regulatory definition, so each company must define its trigger criteria in its SOP. Common approaches:

blocks.zh: 任何超出 UCL/LCL 的點
blocks.en: Any point outside UCL/LCL

blocks.zh: 連續 N 個點在中心線同側（N 由 SPC 規則決定，常用 8）
blocks.en: N consecutive points on the same side of the center line (N is set by the SPC rules; 8 is commonly used)

blocks.zh: 連續 M 個點持續上升或下降（常用 6）
blocks.en: M consecutive points steadily rising or falling (6 is commonly used)

blocks.zh: 穩定性資料的線性回歸斜率超過設定閾值
blocks.en: Linear regression slope of stability data exceeding a set threshold

blocks.zh: Cpk 低於預設警戒值（如 <1.33）
blocks.en: Cpk below a predefined alert value (e.g., <1.33)

blocks.zh: 您的產品蛋白質含量規格：LSL = 95%，USL = 110%（標示值百分比）。最近連續 7 批的結果：102.1, 103.4, 104.2, 105.1, 106.3, 107.0, 108.1（均在規格內但持續上升）。這構成 OOT 嗎？應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: Your product protein content specification: LSL = 95%, USL = 110% (percent of label claim). Results for the last 7 consecutive batches: 102.1, 103.4, 104.2, 105.1, 106.3, 107.0, 108.1 (all within specification but steadily rising). Does this constitute OOT? What action should be taken?

blocks.zh: 一批產品的填充量測試結果為 OOS（低於 LSL）。調查顯示是操作員讀數錯誤，重新測試結果符合規格。整個調查過程必須記錄哪些內容？
blocks.en: A batch has an OOS fill-volume test result (below LSL). The investigation shows an operator reading error, and the retest result meets the specification. What must be documented throughout the investigation?

blocks.zh: 穩定性測試中，12 個月時間點的降解產物比預期趨勢略高，但仍在規格內。這屬於哪種情況？應如何處理？
blocks.en: In stability testing, the degradation product level at the 12-month time point is slightly higher than the expected trend but still within specification. Which situation is this? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: Block 9 | 第九區塊 — Process Changes & Revalidation Triggers | 製程變更與再驗證觸發因子
blocks.en: Block 9 — Process Changes & Revalidation Triggers

blocks.zh: 製程變更與再驗證 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Process Changes and Revalidation — Commentary

blocks.zh: 法規申報要求（美國 FDA）
blocks.en: Regulatory Filing Requirements (US FDA)

blocks.zh: 製程變更除了內部變更管理，還需考慮法規申報：
blocks.en: In addition to internal change management, process changes must be assessed for regulatory filing:

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)：重大變更，需 FDA 批准後才能實施（如廠址變更、重大製程變更）
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS): major changes, which may be implemented only after FDA approval (e.g., site change, major process change)

blocks.zh: CBE-30：中度變更，在實施後 30 天內申報
blocks.en: CBE-30: moderate changes, filed 30 days before implementation

blocks.zh: CBE-0 / Annual Report：輕微變更，年度報告中申報
blocks.en: CBE-0 / Annual Report: minor changes, reported in the annual report

blocks.zh: 法規依據：21 CFR § 314.70（小分子 NDA）；21 CFR § 601.12（生物製品 BLA）
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: 21 CFR § 314.70 (small-molecule NDA); 21 CFR § 601.12 (biologics, BLA)

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車改裝 vs. 出廠規格
blocks.en: Analogy: Car Modification vs. Factory Specification

blocks.zh: 出廠車輛（= PPQ 通過的製程）已被驗證。如果你更換引擎（= 重大製程變更），就需要重新做安全測試（= 再驗證）。只換輪胎氣壓（= 微小調整）可能只需要記錄並確認安全即可。問題的關鍵是：這個改變對「行車安全」（= 產品品質）的影響有多大？
blocks.en: A car as it leaves the factory (= a process that passed PPQ) has been validated. If you replace the engine (= a major process change), you need to redo the safety testing (= revalidation). Merely adjusting tire pressure (= a minor adjustment) may only need to be documented and checked for safety. The key question is: how much does the change affect "driving safety" (= product quality)?

blocks.zh: 您的 CPV 數據顯示 Ppk 持續偏低（~1.05），根本原因為批次間原料黏度變異。您建議調整攪拌速度範圍。這需要哪些步驟才能合規地實施此變更？
blocks.en: Your CPV data show a persistently low Ppk (~1.05), and the root cause is batch-to-batch raw material viscosity variation. You propose adjusting the mixing speed range. What steps are required to implement this change in compliance?

blocks.zh: 設備供應商停止生產您正在使用的蠕動泵，您必須更換為不同型號。這屬於哪個再驗證類別？需要哪些確認活動？
blocks.en: The equipment supplier discontinues the peristaltic pump you are using, and you must switch to a different model. Which revalidation category does this fall into? What qualification activities are required?

blocks.zh: 一個在歐洲生產的產品要增加美國工廠作為備用生產地。需要提交哪種補充申請？需要哪些驗證資料支持？
blocks.en: A product manufactured in Europe is to add a US site as a backup manufacturing location. What type of supplement must be submitted? What validation data are needed to support it?

blocks.zh: Block 10 | 第十區塊 — Facility, Utilities & Equipment Maintenance | 廠房、公用設施與設備維護
blocks.en: Block 10 — Facility, Utilities & Equipment Maintenance

blocks.zh: 設備維護與確認狀態維持 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Equipment Maintenance and Maintaining the Qualified State — Commentary

blocks.zh: 設備確認的持續性
blocks.en: Continuity of Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 設備確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）不是一次性事件，而是需要透過以下機制持續維持：
blocks.en: Equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) is not a one-time event; it must be maintained through the following mechanisms:

blocks.zh: 預防性維護（PM）計畫：定期更換易耗件、潤滑、清潔
blocks.en: Preventive maintenance (PM) program: periodic replacement of consumable parts, lubrication, cleaning

blocks.zh: 校正計畫：量測設備定期校正，維持計量溯源性
blocks.en: Calibration program: periodic calibration of measuring equipment to maintain metrological traceability

blocks.zh: 定期績效驗證（PV）：定期測試設備是否仍符合原確認標準
blocks.en: Periodic performance verification (PV): periodic testing to confirm the equipment still meets the original qualification criteria

blocks.zh: 確認週期評估：根據設備歷史表現決定再確認週期
blocks.en: Requalification interval assessment: determine the requalification interval based on the equipment history

blocks.zh: 再確認頻率的決策依據
blocks.en: Basis for Deciding Requalification Frequency

blocks.zh: FDA 建議根據「回饋資訊」調整維護與校正頻率，這意味著：
blocks.en: FDA recommends adjusting maintenance and calibration frequency based on "feedback information", which means:

blocks.zh: 校正歷史顯示設備穩定 → 可適當延長校正週期
blocks.en: Calibration history shows the equipment is stable: the calibration interval may be extended appropriately

blocks.zh: 校正歷史顯示頻繁漂移 → 應縮短校正週期
blocks.en: Calibration history shows frequent drift: the calibration interval should be shortened

blocks.zh: CPV 資料顯示製程參數漂移與某設備相關 → 觸發非計畫性再確認
blocks.en: CPV data show process parameter drift associated with a particular piece of equipment: triggers unplanned requalification

blocks.zh: 重大維修或更換關鍵零件後 → 需執行再確認
blocks.en: After major repair or replacement of critical parts: requalification must be performed

blocks.zh: 這體現了「以風險為基礎的設備管理」——資源投入與風險成正比。
blocks.en: This reflects "risk-based equipment management": resources invested are proportional to risk.

blocks.zh: CDMO 無菌灌裝特別關注事項
blocks.en: Special Considerations for CDMO Aseptic Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: 填充針、隔膜、蠕動泵管：使用壽命監控與填充量漂移的關聯性
blocks.en: Filling needles, diaphragms, peristaltic pump tubing: monitor service life and its relationship to fill-volume drift

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統：風量平衡、壓差、溫濕度記錄的持續趨勢
blocks.en: HVAC systems: ongoing trends of airflow balance, differential pressure, temperature and humidity records

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌器（Autoclave）：F0 值趨勢，熱電偶校正
blocks.en: Autoclave: F0 value trends, thermocouple calibration

blocks.zh: 凍乾機（Lyophilizer）：真空計校正、貨架溫度均勻性定期測試
blocks.en: Lyophilizer: vacuum gauge calibration, periodic shelf temperature uniformity testing

blocks.zh: 隧道滅菌機（Tunnel）：溫度輪廓定期驗證
blocks.en: Tunnel (depyrogenation tunnel): periodic verification of the temperature profile

blocks.zh: RABS/isolator：手套完整性定期測試、H2O2 殘留趨勢
blocks.en: RABS/isolator: periodic glove integrity testing, H2O2 residual trends

blocks.zh: 您的填充機在過去 18 個月的 PM 記錄顯示活塞磨損速度比預期慢，同時 CPV 資料顯示填充量變異穩定。這兩項資訊如何影響您的 PM 週期決策？
blocks.en: Over the past 18 months, your filler PM records show that piston wear is slower than expected, while CPV data show stable fill-volume variability. How do these two pieces of information affect your PM interval decision?

blocks.zh: 凍乾機真空計的校正歷史顯示每次校正偏差均在規格內且穩定。您能否以此為依據延長校正週期？需要什麼文件支持？
blocks.en: The calibration history of the lyophilizer vacuum gauge shows that each calibration deviation has been within specification and stable. Can you use this as a basis to extend the calibration interval? What documentation is needed to support it?

blocks.zh: Block 11 | 第十一區塊 — Concurrent Release of PPQ Batches | PPQ 批次同期放行
blocks.en: Block 11 — Concurrent Release of PPQ Batches

blocks.zh: 同期放行 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Concurrent Release — Commentary

blocks.zh: 同期放行（Concurrent Release）的定義
blocks.en: Definition of Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: 同期放行是指在 PPQ 協議尚未完全執行完畢的情況下，允許 PPQ 批次進行商業配送。這是常規做法的例外，而非規範。
blocks.en: Concurrent release means allowing PPQ batches to be distributed commercially before the PPQ protocol has been fully executed. It is an exception to normal practice, not the norm.

blocks.zh: FDA 明確表示：「FDA 預期同期放行將被少用（rarely）。」這個 "rarely" 是一個強烈的法規信號。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly: "FDA expects concurrent release to be used rarely." The word "rarely" is a strong regulatory signal.

blocks.zh: 同期放行的風險警示
blocks.en: Risk Warning on Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：如果 Stage 2 確認未成功（即 PPQ 失敗），而部分批次已在同期放行下配送到市場，後果嚴重——因為這意味著可能已放行了在不可重複製程下生產的產品。
blocks.en: FDA points out that if Stage 2 qualification is not successful (that is, PPQ fails) and some batches have already been distributed to the market under concurrent release, the consequences are serious, because product made by a non-reproducible process may already have been released.

blocks.zh: 這是同期放行最大的法規風險：一旦 PPQ 最終結論是「製程未確認」，所有已同期放行的批次都面臨回收（Recall）的可能性。
blocks.en: This is the greatest regulatory risk of concurrent release: once the final PPQ conclusion is that the "process is not qualified", all batches already released concurrently face the possibility of recall.

blocks.zh: 比喻：試映會 vs. 正式上映
blocks.en: Analogy: Preview Screening vs. Official Premiere

blocks.zh: 同期放行就像電影還在剪輯中就讓觀眾進場——理論上可行，但如果剪輯完成後發現劇情根本不通順，觀眾的體驗就已經受損了，而且退票很困難。常規做法是先完成整部電影（完整 PPQ），確認品質後才開始售票（商業放行）。
blocks.en: Concurrent release is like letting the audience in while the film is still being edited: possible in theory, but if the finished cut turns out to have an incoherent plot, the audience experience has already been damaged, and refunds are difficult. The normal practice is to complete the whole film first (complete PPQ) and start selling tickets (commercial release) only after quality is confirmed.

blocks.zh: Block 12 | 第十二區塊 — Concurrent Release: Conditions & Safeguards | 同期放行的條件與防護措施
blocks.en: Block 12 — Concurrent Release: Conditions & Safeguards

blocks.zh: 同期放行的完整要求 — 中文解析
blocks.en: Complete Requirements for Concurrent Release — Commentary

blocks.zh: 同期放行的 6 大必要條件
blocks.en: The 6 Essential Conditions for Concurrent Release

blocks.zh: 1. 預先規劃：同期放行的理由和情境必須在 PPQ 協議中事先完整描述（不能事後補說明）
blocks.en: 1. Advance planning: the rationale and circumstances for concurrent release must be fully described in the PPQ protocol in advance (they cannot be explained after the fact)

blocks.zh: 2. 全面 CGMP 合規：即使在協議尚未完成的情況下，每批次必須完全符合 CGMP 要求
blocks.en: 2. Full CGMP compliance: even though the protocol is not yet complete, every batch must fully comply with CGMP requirements

blocks.zh: 3. 批次放行標準：需達到 PPQ 協議規定的放行標準（通常比常規放行更嚴格的統計置信度）
blocks.en: 3. Batch release criteria: the release criteria specified in the PPQ protocol must be met (usually a higher statistical confidence than for routine release)

blocks.zh: 4. 上市後監控系統：需要建立快速回饋機制，包含客訴、不良報告的快速評估
blocks.en: 4. Post-marketing surveillance system: a rapid feedback mechanism is needed, including prompt evaluation of complaints and adverse event reports

blocks.zh: 5. 穩定性計畫納入：每個同期放行批次都應納入穩定性計畫，且需迅速評估穩定性資料
blocks.en: 5. Inclusion in the stability program: each concurrently released batch should be included in the stability program, and stability data must be evaluated promptly

blocks.zh: 6. PPQ 負面結論的回應：若最終 PPQ 結論為失敗，必須對已放行批次採取適當糾正措施
blocks.en: 6. Response to a negative PPQ conclusion: if the final PPQ conclusion is a failure, appropriate corrective action must be taken for the batches already released

blocks.zh: 「置信水準（Confidence Level）」在 PPQ 放行中的應用
blocks.en: Application of "Confidence Level" in PPQ Release

blocks.zh: 常規商業放行通常基於規格合規（Yes/No）。PPQ 同期放行要求更高的統計保證，例如：
blocks.en: Routine commercial release is usually based on specification compliance (Yes/No). Concurrent release of PPQ batches requires a higher level of statistical assurance, for example:

blocks.zh: 需達到 95% 置信水準，95% 的個體將在規格內（95/95 容忍區間）
blocks.en: Achieve a 95% confidence level that 95% of individual units will be within specification (95/95 tolerance interval)

blocks.zh: 或達到 Ppk ≥ 1.33 的特定標準
blocks.en: Or meet a specific criterion of Ppk ≥ 1.33

blocks.zh: 或多個關鍵屬性的加權統計評估
blocks.en: Or a weighted statistical evaluation of multiple critical attributes

blocks.zh: 具體標準需在 PPQ 協議中事先定義，不能在評估後才決定。
blocks.en: The specific criteria must be defined in the PPQ protocol in advance and cannot be decided after the evaluation.

blocks.zh: 上市後快速監控系統
blocks.en: Rapid Post-Marketing Monitoring System

blocks.zh: 同期放行必須伴隨強化的上市後監控：
blocks.en: Concurrent release must be accompanied by enhanced post-marketing monitoring:

blocks.zh: 設立專門的客訴快速回應流程（縮短正常回應時間）
blocks.en: Set up a dedicated rapid-response complaint process (shorter than the normal response time)

blocks.zh: 建立配銷追蹤系統（知道每批次在哪裡）
blocks.en: Establish a distribution tracking system (know where every batch is)

blocks.zh: 與 FDA 保持溝通（特別是供應短缺情境下的協調）
blocks.en: Maintain communication with FDA (especially for coordination in drug shortage situations)

blocks.zh: 穩定性資料即時審查（不能等到年度審查）
blocks.en: Real-time review of stability data (not waiting for the annual review)

blocks.zh: 任何 PPQ 負面發現立即評估對已放行批次的影響
blocks.en: Any negative PPQ finding is immediately assessed for its impact on batches already released

blocks.zh: 您的公司生產一種孤兒藥，全球僅有約 200 名患者。您正在執行 PPQ（3 批次計畫），第一批 PPQ 資料看起來很好。客戶要求立即供貨，因為目前斷貨。您如何評估是否適合同期放行？需要準備哪些文件？
blocks.en: Your company manufactures an orphan drug, with only about 200 patients worldwide. You are executing PPQ (a 3-batch plan), and the data from the first PPQ batch look good. The customer asks for immediate supply because the product is currently out of stock. How would you evaluate whether concurrent release is appropriate? What documents need to be prepared?

blocks.zh: F-18 PET 顯影劑的半衰期是 110 分鐘。請解釋為什麼傳統 PPQ 完成後再放行對這類產品完全不可行，以及同期放行在此情境的特殊性。
blocks.en: The half-life of the F-18 PET imaging agent is 110 minutes. Explain why releasing only after the traditional PPQ is complete is entirely impractical for this type of product, and what is special about concurrent release in this situation.

blocks.zh: 一個同期放行批次已配送出去，隨後第二批 PPQ 的無菌測試 OOS 調查顯示培養基模擬試驗存在系統性問題。您需要採取什麼行動？涉及哪些法規條款？
blocks.en: A concurrently released batch has already been distributed, and the OOS investigation of the sterility test for the second PPQ batch then reveals a systematic problem with the media fill. What actions must you take? Which regulatory provisions are involved?

blocks.zh: Block 13 | 第十三區塊 — CDMO Aseptic Fill-Finish: CPV Implementation | CDMO 無菌灌裝 CPV 實施
blocks.en: Block 13 — CDMO Aseptic Fill-Finish: CPV Implementation

blocks.zh: CDMO 無菌灌裝的 CPV 實施策略
blocks.en: CPV Implementation Strategy for CDMO Aseptic Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝 CPV 特有監控項目
blocks.en: CPV Monitoring Items Specific to Aseptic Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）趨勢：浮游菌、沉降菌、表面微生物、非活性微粒——月度趨勢圖，識別季節性或設施退化
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) trends: viable air, settle plates, surface microbiology, non-viable particles; monthly trend charts to identify seasonality or facility degradation

blocks.zh: 培養基模擬試驗（MFT/Media Fill）：每次執行結果趨勢，長期合格率監控
blocks.en: Media fill (MFT/APS): trend of the results of each run, with long-term monitoring of the pass rate

blocks.zh: 容器封閉完整性（CCIT）：高壓滅菌後殘留氧氣趨勢、染料侵入測試結果
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCIT): residual oxygen trends after autoclaving, dye ingress test results

blocks.zh: 可見異物（VPI）：每批次異物比率趨勢，依異物類型分類統計
blocks.en: Visible particulates (VPI): per-batch particulate rate trend, with statistics classified by particle type

blocks.zh: 無菌測試（SAL）：雖為百分之百通過/失敗，仍需趨勢監控（即使零陽性，也需確認測試方法的持續有效性）
blocks.en: Sterility test (SAL): although it is 100% pass/fail, it still needs trend monitoring (even with zero positives, the continued validity of the test method must be confirmed)

blocks.zh: 殘留溶媒：適用於使用有機溶劑的配方（如脂質奈米粒子）
blocks.en: Residual solvents: applicable to formulations using organic solvents (e.g., lipid nanoparticles)

blocks.zh: CDMO CPV 計畫的優先順序建議
blocks.en: Recommended Prioritization of the CDMO CPV Program

blocks.zh: 高優先順序（必須在首批商業化生產前建立）：
blocks.en: High priority (must be established before the first commercial batch):

blocks.zh: 填充量 CPV（Xbar-R chart，Cpk/Ppk 月度計算）
blocks.en: Fill volume CPV (Xbar-R chart, monthly Cpk/Ppk calculation)

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢計畫（月度趨勢報告，OOT 定義）
blocks.en: EM trending program (monthly trend report, OOT definition)

blocks.zh: 批次良率趨勢
blocks.en: Batch yield trend

blocks.zh: 中優先順序（首年內建立）：
blocks.en: Medium priority (establish within the first year):

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備參數趨勢（填充速度、蒸汽壓力、凍乾曲線）
blocks.en: Critical equipment parameter trends (fill speed, steam pressure, lyophilization cycle)

blocks.zh: 原料 CoA 關鍵參數趨勢
blocks.en: Raw material CoA critical parameter trends

blocks.zh: CCIT 趨勢
blocks.en: CCIT trends

blocks.zh: 持續優化：基於早期 CPV 資料結果，識別最重要的變異來源並優先監控。
blocks.en: Continuous optimization: based on early CPV data results, identify the most important sources of variation and prioritize their monitoring.

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 正在技術轉移一個已在原廠生產了 3 年的生物製品。原廠有完整的 CPV 歷史資料。技術轉移完成後，您需要從 Stage 1 重新開始，還是可以利用原廠的 CPV 資料？需要哪些額外確認活動？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is performing a technology transfer of a biologic that has been manufactured at the originator site for 3 years, and the originator site has a complete CPV history. After the technology transfer is complete, do you need to start again from Stage 1, or can you leverage the originator site CPV data? What additional qualification activities are required?

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 同時服務 Client A（美國 FDA 申請）和 Client B（EMA 申請）。兩個客戶對 CPV 的統計方法要求不同。您如何在同一個設施、同一條生產線上管理這兩套要求？
blocks.en: Your CDMO serves both Client A (US FDA filing) and Client B (EMA filing). The two clients have different statistical method requirements for CPV. How do you manage both sets of requirements in the same facility and on the same production line?

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢顯示過去 6 個月 Grade B 區域的浮游菌數量緩慢上升（從平均 0.1 CFU/m³ 升至 0.8 CFU/m³，規格 <1 CFU/m³）。這屬於 OOT 嗎？應採取什麼行動？如何決定是否暫停生產？
blocks.en: EM trends show that the viable air counts in the Grade B area have slowly risen over the past 6 months (from an average of 0.1 CFU/m³ to 0.8 CFU/m³, against a limit of <1 CFU/m³). Is this OOT? What action should be taken? How do you decide whether to suspend production?

blocks.zh: Stage 3 Comprehensive Summary | 第三階段完整摘要
blocks.en: Stage 3 Comprehensive Summary

blocks.zh: The Validation Lifecycle Loop | 驗證生命週期迴路
blocks.en: The Validation Lifecycle Loop

blocks.zh: Stage 3 不是終點，而是一個持續改善的循環起點。CPV 資料發現的改善機會，回饋至 Stage 1（製程設計），觸發新的確認活動，形成真正的生命週期驗證迴路。
blocks.en: Stage 3 is not the end point but the starting point of a continual improvement cycle. Improvement opportunities identified from CPV data feed back into Stage 1 (process design) and trigger new qualification activities, forming a true lifecycle validation loop.

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 核心訊息
blocks.en: Core Messages of FDA 2011

blocks.zh: 驗證不是事件，而是持續的承諾
blocks.en: Validation is not an event but an ongoing commitment

blocks.zh: 統計方法是 CPV 的核心語言
blocks.en: Statistical methods are the core language of CPV

blocks.zh: OOT 系統讓你在問題變成危機前介入
blocks.en: The OOT system lets you intervene before a problem becomes a crisis

blocks.zh: 同期放行是罕見例外，需要充分科學依據
blocks.en: Concurrent release is a rare exception and requires sound scientific justification

blocks.zh: 任何重大變更都可能重新啟動驗證週期
blocks.en: Any significant change may restart the validation cycle

blocks.zh: 設備與廠房的持續確認狀態是製程控制的基礎
blocks.en: The continued qualified state of equipment and facilities is the foundation of process control

blocks.zh: Block 14 | 第十四區塊 — Comprehensive Practice Questions | 綜合練習題
blocks.en: Block 14 — Comprehensive Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 綜合練習題 — 中文版
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice Questions

blocks.zh: B 組：應用情境題
blocks.en: Set B: Application Scenarios

blocks.zh: 一個無菌注射劑在商業生產 18 個月後，您的 CPV 月度報告顯示：填充量 Cpk 穩定（1.48），EM 趨勢正常，但批次良率（合格可見異物）從 99.7% 緩慢下降至 98.9%。這是否構成 OOT？您建議採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: An aseptic injectable has been in commercial production for 18 months. Your monthly CPV report shows: fill-volume Cpk stable (1.48), EM trends normal, but batch yield (acceptable visible particulate) has slowly declined from 99.7% to 98.9%. Does this constitute OOT? What action do you recommend?

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 客戶要求你將 CPV 取樣頻率從每批取 30 個單位減少為每批取 10 個單位，理由是節省成本且過去 2 年從未出現 OOS。您如何評估這個請求？需要哪些統計依據才能支持此決定？
blocks.en: Your CDMO client asks you to reduce the CPV sampling from 30 units per batch to 10 units per batch, on the grounds of cost savings and no OOS in the past 2 years. How do you evaluate this request? What statistical justification is needed to support the decision?

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時，查核員要求查閱過去 3 年的 CPV 趨勢報告，並詢問為什麼沒有 Ppk 計算，只有 Cpk。您如何解釋兩者的差異，以及在什麼情況下兩者都需要計算？
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, the investigator asks to see the CPV trend reports for the past 3 years and asks why only Cpk was calculated and not Ppk. How do you explain the difference between the two, and under what circumstances are both needed?

blocks.zh: 您的公司正在開發一個 PET 顯影劑（F-18 FDG），計畫同期放行。FDA 查廠時詢問您的 PPQ 協議中如何描述同期放行的理由和防護措施。請草擬此協議相關段落的要點。
blocks.en: Your company is developing a PET imaging agent (F-18 FDG) and plans concurrent release. During an FDA inspection, you are asked how your PPQ protocol describes the rationale and safeguards for concurrent release. Draft the key points of the relevant protocol section.

blocks.zh: 一個凍乾生物製品在第 36 個月穩定性測試中，蛋白質聚集體比例超出規格。產品仍在貨架上（已配送給醫院）。依據 § 211.192 和 CPV 原則，您需要採取哪些緊急步驟？
blocks.en: A lyophilized biologic exceeds the specification for protein aggregate level at the 36-month stability time point. The product is still on the shelf (already distributed to hospitals). Based on § 211.192 and CPV principles, what urgent steps must you take?

blocks.zh: C 組：進階法規策略題
blocks.en: Set C: Advanced Regulatory Strategy Questions

blocks.zh: 您的年度 PQR 顯示 Cpk 從第一年（1.68）→ 第二年（1.52）→ 第三年（1.35）持續下降，但始終高於 1.00 且無 OOS 事件。您需要在 PQR 中如何記錄此趨勢？需要啟動何種調查或行動？如何判斷是否需要再驗證？
blocks.en: Your annual PQR shows Cpk declining from year one (1.68) to year two (1.52) to year three (1.35), but always above 1.00 with no OOS events. How should you document this trend in the PQR? What investigation or action needs to be started? How do you determine whether revalidation is needed?

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 同時為一個 NDA 持有人（FDA）和一個 MAA 持有人（EMA）生產同一分子不同劑型。美國要求 CPV 包含 Cpk/Ppk，歐盟 GMP 更強調風險基礎方法和 APR。如何設計一個單一的 CPV 框架，同時滿足兩個法規要求？
blocks.en: Your CDMO manufactures different dosage forms of the same molecule for an NDA holder (FDA) and an MAA holder (EMA). The US requires CPV to include Cpk/Ppk, while EU GMP places more emphasis on a risk-based approach and the APR. How would you design a single CPV framework that satisfies both regulatory requirements?

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 指引第 18 頁提到製程改善資料需包含「描述、理由、實施計畫、QA 批准」。請舉一個具體的 CDMO 無菌灌裝製程改善案例，說明這四個要素的實際內容應如何撰寫。
blocks.en: Page 18 of the 2011 FDA guidance states that process improvement data should include "a description, rationale, implementation plan and QA approval". Give a specific CDMO aseptic fill-finish process improvement example and explain how the content of each of these four elements should actually be written.
